nodes.title: Unfold in place

nodes.title: Anchor + inspector
nodes.direction: Keep graph nodes compact and stable; selection reveals the full title, teaser and action in a separate inspector.

nodes.title: Neighborhood portal
nodes.direction: Enter a node to show its parent and immediate next steps; navigate deeper or retrace the breadcrumb.

nodes.title: Quiet map
nodes.direction: A fresh circle-only map. Select a node to trace its route while every node stays in place; only titles appear beside the status circles.

nodes.title: Foldable branches
nodes.direction: A fresh circle-only tree. Select a node to fold or unfold its descendants; a small non-text notch indicates a folded branch.

nodes.title: One neighborhood
nodes.direction: A fresh circle-only neighborhood. Select a node to center its parent and children; return through the parent or the home control.

nodes.title: Subject and branches
nodes.direction: From r002-01: retain the complete map and path highlighting; vary circle size by graph depth, with centered titles and a larger subject anchor.

nodes.title: Trace the route

nodes.title: Breathing lantern

nodes.title: Steady light
nodes.direction: Quiet map (r002-01) keeps the layout, Amber lantern (r004-01) keeps the palette, and Trace the route (r005-02) supplies the route direction. A single light moves at steady speed only along newly highlighted segments; existing shared paths stay still.

nodes.title: Gentle passage
nodes.direction: Quiet map (r002-01) keeps the layout, Amber lantern (r004-01) keeps the palette, and Trace the route (r005-02) supplies the route direction. The light eases into and out of the new route section as one continuous journey; no line redraw.

nodes.title: Junction relay
nodes.direction: Quiet map (r002-01) keeps the layout, Amber lantern (r004-01) keeps the palette, and Trace the route (r005-02) supplies the route direction. One light travels new segments in sequence, pausing 140 ms at each junction; shared segments never replay.
